Build the query for the references linked to a selection

Source: R/build_reference_query.R
build_reference_query.Rd

Build a lazy query that returns the references linked, through the link table sel_table, to the ids in the column sel_column of data_source. The ids are given to SQLite as a subquery of the distinct ids of data_source, never as a literal list. DISTINCT lets SQLite skip the joins of data_source that do not change the ids.

Usage

build_reference_query(data_source, sel_con, sel_column, sel_table)

Arguments

data_source

A lazy tbl_sql that holds the column sel_column.

sel_con

A SQLiteConnection to the Vault database.

sel_column

Name of the id column, for example "dataset_id".

sel_table

Name of the link table between sel_column and References, for example "DatasetReferences".

Value

A lazy tbl_sql with one row per distinct linked reference and the columns reference_id, reference_detail and mandatory. A reference id of the link table that is missing from References keeps NA in reference_detail and mandatory.

See also

get_references(), build_reference_link_table()
